description.value:
Duration constant

The first ranged Strike you make in each encounter is resolved as though it were made at your weapon’s maximum range increment, taking the full distance damage no matter where the target actually stands — across a valley or across the table. You are never off-guard at the start of an encounter, and you may make that Strike even if you have not yet acted in the initiative order.

cinderfall.incomplete: "distance damage" is the homebrew Draw ladder, not a real PF2E field. The "may act even without having rolled initiative" clause has no rule-element hook either: grepped pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats for "act first"/ "acts first" (zero hits) and confirmed initiative sequencing isn't exposed to system.rules — it's a Foundry combat-tracker mechanic, not an actor property. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
